exact_claim_text: Within the declared synthetic corpus, the linear classifier improves macro-averaged held-out performance over the keyword baseline, but minority-class calibration and ambiguous-request errors remain unresolved.
method_or_source: Keyword-rule baseline versus regularised linear classifier, with held-out evaluation, calibration and class-specific error analysis.
uncertainty: Synthetic language, label design, split dependence, class imbalance and absence of distribution-shift testing.
boundary: Synthetic corpus, four routing classes and one held-out split; no real service messages, production deployment or fairness claim.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: The minority class shows poor calibration and several ambiguous requests are confidently misrouted.
stronger_wording_rejected: The classifier can automate service routing in production.
